settings.rate.label: Rate
settings.rate.description: Clicks or key presses per second (or minute, depending on the unit).
settings.rate_unit.label: Rate unit
settings.rate_unit.description: Whether the rate is measured per second or per minute.
settings.action.label: Action
settings.action.description: What to repeat while the clicker is running.
settings.custom_key.label: Custom key
settings.custom_key.description: A single key or chord, for example space, enter, or ctrl+shift+a.
settings.hold_ms.label: Button hold
settings.hold_ms.description: How long the button or key stays down on each press. Automatically shortened at very high rates.
settings.jitter_pct.label: Timing jitter
settings.jitter_pct.description: Random variation in each interval, as a percentage. Zero is perfectly regular.
settings.start_delay.label: Start delay
settings.start_delay.description: Countdown before clicking starts, so you can switch to the game window.
settings.max_duration.label: Maximum duration
settings.max_duration.description: Stop automatically after this many seconds. Zero means run until stopped.
settings.target_app.label: Target window
settings.target_app.description: Optional class or title substring. The clicker only runs while that window is focused.
settings.stop_on_focus_loss.label: Stop on focus loss
settings.stop_on_focus_loss.description: Stop when the focused window no longer matches the target window.
settings.show_osd.label: Show OSD
settings.show_osd.description: Show a small on-screen popup when the clicker starts or stops.
settings.notify.label: Notifications
settings.notify.description: Show notifications for errors and macro completion.
settings.helper_path.label: Helper binary
settings.helper_path.description: Path to clickerd. Run clicker/helper/install.sh to build and install it.
settings.macro_default_repeat.label: Default macro repeat
settings.macro_default_repeat.descriptio: Repeat count for newly created macros. Zero loops until stopped.
settings.macro_default_loop_delay.label: Default loop delay
settings.macro_default_loop_delay.descri: Delay between macro repeats, in milliseconds.
settings.macro_max_runtime.label: Macro runtime cap
settings.macro_max_runtime.description: Safety cap for macros that loop forever, in seconds. Zero uses the macro's own value.
settings.widget.hide_when_idle.label: Hide when idle
settings.widget.hide_when_idle.descripti: Only show the bar widget while the clicker or a macro is active.
settings.widget.show_rate.label: Show rate
settings.widget.show_rate.description: Show the current rate next to the widget glyph.
panel.title: Clicker
panel.session_note: Panel changes apply to this session. Use Settings to change defaults.
panel.macro.name: Name
panel.macro.no_steps: No steps yet. Add one below.
panel.macro.select_step: Select a step to edit it.
panel.macro.name_invalid: Use 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, or dashes.
panel.macro.name_exists: A macro with that name already exists.
